records.title: Coinbase cbXRP proof of reserves
records.note: Coinbase's indexed official dashboard snapshot says data refreshed Oct 29 2026 09:14 UTC: 151,405,263.6 XRP reserve backing 151,403,016.07 cbXRP on Base, a 2,247.53 XRP excess (about 100.00148% coverage). Multiple regional Coinbase page results show the same reserve/supply values later on Oct 29. Direct page open in this capture returned an older Oct 6 cached figure, so the live dashboard cache discrepancy is retained; the Oct29 indexed snapshot predates the Binance incident.

records.title: Coinbase Wrapped Assets product documentation
records.note: Coinbase says its wrapped assets are backed 1:1 by underlying assets held in Coinbase custody; cbXRP is supported on Base. Coinbase describes minting by withdrawing the underlying asset to a supported network and automatic unwrapping when the wrapped token is deposited back to Coinbase.

records.title: Binance DEX lists XRP-pegged token XRP-BF2
records.note: Binance's 2019 official announcement says XRP-BF2 is issued on Binance Chain/BNB Chain and backed 1:1 by native XRP in a publicly disclosed address. It establishes the mechanism and historical issuer claim, not the current 325.8M reserve amount reported by XRP Insights.

records.title: XRP Insights exchange balances and wrapped-asset reserve decomposition
records.note: XRP Insights reports 22.58B XRP in 701 publicly attributed wallets across 24 exchanges as of Oct 29 08:00 UTC. It identifies 488.4M XRP in those tracked wallets as wrapped-asset reserves/funds rather than customer deposits: 325.8M Binance XRP-BF2 backing Binance-Peg XRP on BNB Chain, 151.4M Coinbase wallets backing cbXRP on Base, and 11.2M insurance/charity funds. Same-wallet tracked balances were down 17.4M over 7 days and up 35.8M over 30 days. This is a public-label aggregation, not exchange proprietary inventory or tradable float.
